relationships.subject: HDAC5
relationships.evidence_quote: Restoration of STAT3 signaling or inhibition of HDAC5 rescued astrocyte deficiency and attenuated PDN in the T1D model

key_findings: In T1D rats, HDAC5 is activated in spinal astrocytes and deacetylates STAT3, causing astrocyte loss and pain hypersensitivity.
Restoring STAT3 signaling or inhibiting HDAC5 rescues astrocytes and attenuates PDN.
